title: When workers run as the topology owner, the Logviewer serves files that a worker has placed in its… (CVE-2026-124495)
description: A vulnerability exists where the Logviewer serves files placed by a worker running as the topology owner as links to other files. This allows a user who can submit topologies to read logs of other users' topologies and other files accessible to the Logviewer process. The issue is fixed in version 3.2.0.
